notes: Other is dropped: Kangaroo names the source exactly, so the facets fully specify the food. The 2020 maintenance report adds Other only when they cannot, which supersedes the 2015 practice.

The 2015 code uses whole eggs, with free text source = eagle, because eagle was not a source. Eggs from birds not separately listed now exists, and Kites, Hawks and Eagles is the source. That family also includes kites and hawks, so eagle eggs cannot be reconstructed from the code and stays as free text. Other is not added: the base is already the group for birds without their own egg term.

The 2015 code uses the general flour group plus Other, because quinoa flour was not listed. Cereal and cereal-like flours not separately listed now exists, so the flour is coded there, with quinoa grain as the source commodity. Other is not added: the base is already the group for flours without their own term.

The 2015 code names the animal because kangaroo meat was not a commodity. Kangaroo fresh meat now exists, so the dried meat is coded from that commodity. Other is dropped: that commodity names the meat exactly, so the facets fully specify the food (EFSA 2020 maintenance report, which supersedes the 2015 practice).

The 2015 code uses free text, source raw commodity = pelican egg, because pelican was not a source. Pelican egg still does not exist as a commodity. Pelicans is the family, and Pelecanus is the only genus under it, so the source is the genus. Other is dropped: the genus is exactly the pelicans, so the facets fully specify the food (EFSA 2020 maintenance report, which supersedes the 2015 practice).

Follows EFSA's own code: candying makes a new food and coating does not, so the base is Candied fruits, with chocolate as a minor ingredient and chocolate coating as a process. The catalogue files candied orange peel under Candied fruits. Two departures from the published code: Chocolate and similar instead of Bitter chocolate, because the description does not say bitter; and Candying, which the description states and which is narrower than the implied Preserving with sugars. An earlier proposal (A034R, 2026-11-13) was reverted to EFSA on 2026-11-25.
